qa_pair.question: Among the projects whose status is active, exactly one has a note that does not link to any other note. What is the job role of the person who owns that project?
One team member's personal note refers to a document that does not exist anywhere in the vault yet. What is the title of that missing document?
The team's Lead Researcher owns exactly one project that is still active. How many distinct notes link to or embed that project's note? Answer with a number only.

The kickoff meeting quotes a single paragraph of a project note by embedding it. What spending limit, in euros, does that paragraph state? Answer with digits only, without separators or a currency sign.
The groundwater pilot project note embeds one section of a reference procedure. What is the first sub-section heading inside that embedded section? Give the heading text only.
In the long table of raw readings from the pressure stations, what water temperature in degrees Celsius did station S-05 report in its most recent reading? Answer with the number only.
How many distinct placeholder variables does the vault's meeting template ask to be filled in? Answer with a number only.
Exactly one note tagged as a project is not stored in the projects folder. Which team does the owner of that project belong to?
Which person is listed as an attendee of both recorded meetings? Give their full name.
Of the projects that are not finished, which one started first? Answer with the project's short name as used in its file name.
